nurse_ratio_1_2_or_1_1_intensive_care:
• HFOV, Ventilator, NIPPV, CPAP/BCPAP, High flow or Vapotherm >4 liters
• Chest Tube(s)
• iNO
nurse_ratio_1_2_3_intermediate_care:
• High flow or Vapotherm ≤4 liters
• Extubated or off NIPPV/CPAP/BCPAP <24 hours
nurse_ratio_1_3_4_continuing_care: RA (or home oxygen without titration parameters)

nurse_ratio_1_2_or_1_1_intensive_care:
• UAC/PAL for BP monitoring
• Vasoactive medications/volume support
• Cardiopulmonary resuscitation or acute pulmonary cardiac arrest

• TPN/Lipids and/or IV fluids
• First 24 hours of trophic feeds
nurse_ratio_1_2_3_intermediate_care:
• NPO
• Partial/Trophic feeds
• TPN/Lipids and/or IV fluids (weaning)

nurse_ratio_1_2_or_1_1_intensive_care:
• Active seizures
• IV sedation (NON NAS)
• Therapeutic Hypothermia/HIE*

• Multiple bili-lights and IV hydration and/or exchange transfusion*
• IVIG therapy
Multiple in 12 hours (Packed RBCs, platelets, cryo, FFP, etc.)

nurse_ratio_1_3_continuing_care:
• IV saline lock or TKO
• PICC w/ long term antibiotics in stable neonate

nurse_ratio_1_2_or_1_1_intensive_care:
• Life threatening congenital anomaly
• DIC/pulmonary hemorrhage <24 hours
• Bedside surgical procedure*

infant_body_system: *1:1 staffing in the NICU: Hemodynamically unstable due to oxygenation and perfusion insufficiencies requiring frequent nurse interventions every 15 minutes including, but not limited to, multiple invasive lines, multiple vasopressor titrations, and fluid and/or blood resuscitation. HFOV w/ INO until stable, Therapeutic Hypothermia, Exchange blood transfusions for first four hours, and neonatal death for the first four hours. (policy: CLN.03.02) Bedside surgical procedures to be 1:1 during procedure.
